note: The narration, one entry per spoken line. Edit here, then re-run justinclips/tools/shortbuild.py. '...' = a held beat before the punchline. Years/numbers stay digits (the D2 tool spells them for the TTS; captions keep digits).

lines.text: A man sold a country that didn't exist.
In 1822, Gregor MacGregor told London he ruled a land called Poyais.
He printed a guidebook, its own money... and sold its government bonds.
Investors bought about 200,000 pounds of them.
They found... jungle. No towns. No capital. No country.
MacGregor was later tried for fraud in France... and acquitted.
